menuText.title: Menu text
menuText.description: Free menu text, one dish per line. Formats: 'Dish name: ingredient, ingredient' or 'Dish name - ingredients' or 'Dish name (ingredients)'. Prices at the end of a line are ignored; lines starting with # are skipped.

recipeUrls.title: Recipe URLs
recipeUrls.description: Recipe page URLs. Each page is fetched and its schema.org Recipe JSON-LD (incl. @graph) is parsed (name + recipeIngredient). Pages without a Recipe produce an error item (not charged).

languages.title: Languages (optional hint)
languages.description: Restrict the keyword dictionaries to these languages (English is always included). Leave empty to use all: en, it, fr, nl, de, es.
